trace.question: How many unknown power cards contain info about the triggered ability
trace.evidence: unknown power cards refers to power is null or power = '*';contain info about the triggered ability refers to text contains 'triggered ability'

attempts.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM cards
WHERE (power IS NULL OR power = '*')
  AND text LIKE '%triggered ability%'
